scanNote: 15a-mashqdagi jadvalning 4 ta katagi (Paul: count, ride a bicycle; Doug: walk, swim) FAQAT audiodan aniqlanadi — kitobda yozilmagan. Ular to'qib yozilmadi, ochiq belgilandi.
audioRequiredUz: 15a — ikki erkakning suhbati (yoshlar jadvali). 16a — 4 ta gapdagi to'g'ri so'zni tanlash (matn o'qilgach o'zingiz tekshirasiz).

exercises.explanationUz:
COULD — 'can' fe'lining O'TGAN ZAMONI

  TASDIQ       I/you/he, etc  COULD swim.
  INKOR        I/you/he, etc  COULDN'T swim.
  SO'ROQ       COULD I/you/he, etc  swim?
  QISQA JAVOB  Yes, I/you/he, etc COULD.
               No,  I/you/he, etc COULDN'T.

UCH MUHIM QOIDA:

  1) HAMMA EGA UCHUN BIR XIL — COULD.
     I could, he could, they could — -S YO'Q.

  2) KEYINGI FE'L ASOSIY SHAKLDA, 'to' SIZ:
        I could swim.       ✓
        I could to swim.    ✗ XATO
        I could swam.       ✗ XATO

  3) 'DID' KERAK EMAS:
        Could you swim?     ✓
        Did you could swim? ✗ XATO

QISQARTMA:
  could not → couldn't

MA'NOSI:
  could = qo'lidan kelardi, bila olardi (O'TGAN QOBILIYAT)
  Misol: I could swim when I was five.
         (Besh yoshimda suza olardim.)

DIQQAT — WHEN va UNTIL:
  ... COULD ... WHEN he was one.
     = bir yoshida ALLAQACHON qila olardi
  ... COULDN'T ... UNTIL he was two.
     = ikki yoshigacha qila OLMASDI
       (ya'ni ikki yoshida boshladi)
  'until' DOIM inkor bilan keladi.

points.en: I / you / he, etc could swim.
points.noteUz:
TASDIQ. 'could' hamma ega uchun bir xil.
Keyingi fe'l — asosiy shaklda, 'to' siz.

points.en: I / you / he, etc couldn't swim.
points.noteUz: INKOR: could + not = couldn't.

points.en: Could I / you / he, etc swim?
points.noteUz:
SO'ROQ: COULD gap boshiga chiqadi.
'did' KERAK EMAS.

points.en: Yes, I could. / No, I couldn't.
points.noteUz:
Qisqa javobda 'could/couldn't' TAKRORLANADI,
asosiy fe'l takrorlanmaydi.

I can swim now. → I could swim then.
Hozirgi zamon 'can', o'tgan zamon 'could'.
Paul could talk WHEN he was one.

Doug couldn't talk UNTIL he was two.
'until' DOIM inkor bilan.

exercises.instructionEn: Listen to the two men talking about themselves and fill in the missing ages in the table below.
exercises.instructionUz: O'zlari haqida gapirayotgan ikki kishini tinglang va quyidagi jadvaldagi tushib qolgan yoshlarni yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
JADVAL (kitobda bosilgan holi):

                      PAUL      DOUG
  talk                 1        .....
  count              .....        3
  read                 2          5
  walk                 2        .....
  ride a bicycle     .....       10
  swim                 4        .....

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA GAPDAN BITTA KATAK TO'LADI:
  'Paul could talk when he was ONE, but Doug couldn't
   talk until he was TWO.'
  → Doug / talk = 2

SHUNDAY QILIB TO'LIQ BILINADIGAN QATORLAR:
  talk  →  Paul 1, Doug 2   (namunadan)
  read  →  Paul 2, Doug 5   (kitobda bosilgan)

QOLGAN 4 KATAK FAQAT AUDIODAN ANIQLANADI:
  Paul / count            = ?
  Paul / ride a bicycle   = ?
  Doug / walk             = ?
  Doug / swim             = ?

Bu raqamlar kitobda YOZILMAGAN — audio tinglanmasa
bilib bo'lmaydi. Shuning uchun bu yerda TO'QIB
yozilmadi. Audioni tinglaganingizda o'zingiz
to'ldirasiz va quyidagi qolip bilan gap tuzasiz.

GAP QOLIPI:
  Paul could [fe'l] when he was [yosh], but Doug
  couldn't [fe'l] until he was [yosh].

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to count = sanamoq
  to ride a bicycle = velosiped haydamoq
  an age = yosh

exercises.instructionEn: Then make sentences, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  Paul could talk when he was one, but Doug couldn't
  talk until he was two.

QOLIP:
  Paul COULD [fe'l] WHEN he was [yosh],
  but Doug COULDN'T [fe'l] UNTIL he was [yosh].

DIQQAT — QAYSI SO'Z QAYERDA:
  tasdiq qismda → WHEN  (o'sha yoshda qila olardi)
  inkor qismda  → UNTIL (o'sha yoshgacha qila olmasdi)

Quyida jadvalda TO'LIQ bosilgan qatorlar bo'yicha gaplar
berilgan. Qolgan 4 qator uchun raqamlarni audiodan
yozib olib, xuddi shu qolip bilan gap tuzasiz.

items.textEn: talk — Paul: 1, Doug: 2
items.answer: Paul could talk when he was one, but Doug couldn't talk until he was two.
items.whyUz:
Tasdiq → WHEN he was one.
Inkor → UNTIL he was two.
'talk' — 'could' dan keyin asosiy shaklda, 'to' siz.

items.textEn: read — Paul: 2, Doug: 5
items.answer: Paul could read when he was two, but Doug couldn't read until he was five.
items.whyUz:
Namunadagi qolipning aynan o'zi.
Paul 2 yoshda o'qiy olardi; Doug 5 yoshgacha o'qiy olmasdi.

exercises.instructionEn: Now talk about yourself, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  I could talk when I was one, but I couldn't count
  until I was three. ...

DIQQAT — 15a dan FARQI:
  15a da IKKI ODAM solishtirilgan (Paul va Doug).
  15b da BITTA odam — O'ZINGIZ — ning turli qobiliyatlari
  solishtiriladi. Shuning uchun ikkala qismda ham 'I'.

QOLIP:
  I could [fe'l] when I was [yosh], but I couldn't
  [boshqa fe'l] until I was [yosh].

JADVALDAGI OLTI FE'L:
  talk, count, read, walk, ride a bicycle, swim

structure.heading: 1  talk / count
structure.guideUz: Kitobdagi namunaning o'zi. Yoshlarni o'zingiznikiga almashtiring.
structure.modelEn: I could talk when I was one, but I couldn't count until I was three.

structure.heading: 2  walk / ride a bicycle
structure.guideUz: Yurish erta, velosiped kech o'rganiladi — shuning uchun juft bo'lib yaxshi keladi.
structure.modelEn: I could walk when I was one, but I couldn't ride a bicycle until I was six.

structure.heading: 3  read / swim
structure.guideUz: Har kimda turlicha — o'z yoshingizni yozing.
structure.modelEn: I could read when I was five, but I couldn't swim until I was eight.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the sentences and explain the words in bold.
exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni o'qing va qalin yozilgan so'zlarni tushuntiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
SAKKIZ QALIN SO'Z — TO'RT JUFT:
  brick ↔ stone
  wide  ↔ narrow
  baths ↔ showers
  balls ↔ dolls

Har bir juftda BITTASI matnga to'g'ri keladi.
Avval so'zlarning ma'nosini biling, so'ng matnni
o'qib yoki audio tinglab tanlaysiz.

points.noteUz:
Pishirilgan loydan qilingan qurilish materiali.
'a brick house' = g'ishtdan qurilgan uy.

Tabiiy tosh.
64-betda 'stone cottages' (tosh kulbalar) bor edi.

Bir chetdan ikkinchisiga masofasi katta.
Aksi: narrow.

Aksi: wide.
'narrow streets' = tor ko'chalar.

'a bath' = vanna, hammom.
'the public baths' = umumiy hammomlar —
qadimgi Rimda mashhur dam olish joyi edi.

Tepadan suv sepiladigan yuvinish moslamasi.
Qadimgi Rimda dush YO'Q edi.
'ball games' = to'p o'yinlari — o'g'il bolalar o'ynagan.
Qizlar o'ynaydigan o'yinchoq.

exercises.instructionEn: Then listen and underline the correct words.
exercises.instructionUz: So'ng tinglang va to'g'ri so'zlarning tagiga chizing.
exercises.explanationUz:
Javoblarni O'NG TOMONDAGI MATNDAN ham tekshirsa bo'ladi —
u yerda hammasi yozilgan.

MATNDAGI JOYLARI:
  1  'they had beautiful BRICK houses'
  2  'Ancient Rome had NARROW streets'
  3  'The public BATHS were very popular'
  4  'the girls had DOLLS to play with'

items.textEn: 1  Some ancient Romans had beautiful brick / stone houses.
items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'they had beautiful BRICK houses'.
Boy rimliklar g'ishtdan uy qurgan.
'stone' — 64-betdagi Inishmore kulbalari uchun edi.

items.textEn: 2  Ancient Rome had wide / narrow streets.
items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'Ancient Rome had NARROW streets, but there were
lots of theatres'.
'narrow' = tor (aksi: wide = keng).

items.textEn: 3  The public baths / showers were very popular.
items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'The public BATHS were very popular'.
Qadimgi Rimda dush yo'q edi — umumiy hammomlar bor edi.

items.textEn: 4  Girls had balls / dolls to play with.
items.hintUz: Matnda o'g'il va qiz bolalar ajratilgan
items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'The boys' favourite games were ball games and
the girls had DOLLS to play with'.
O'g'illar — to'p, qizlar — qo'g'irchoq.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the text and fill in were(n't), had, was or could(n't).
exercises.instructionUz: Matnni o'qing va were(n't), had, was yoki could(n't) ni qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ MATN (to'ldirilgan holda):

  Some ancient Romans WERE very rich and they HAD beautiful
  brick houses. There WEREN'T any windows on the outside
  walls and there WEREN'T any carpets on the floors. Other
  people HAD smaller houses or flats. Ancient Rome HAD
  narrow streets, but there WERE lots of theatres. The
  public baths WERE very popular. Men and women COULD go
  there at different times, but children COULDN'T use the
  baths. Hunting, riding, fishing and having dinner parties
  with friends WERE also popular free-time activities.
  There WERE lots of games and toys for children. The boys'
  favourite games WERE ball games and the girls HAD dolls
  to play with. Children also HAD dogs, cats, ducks and
  geese as pets. The ancient Romans HAD lots of delicious
  food to eat, such as meat, fish, fruit, vegetables and
  bread, and their favourite drink WAS wine.

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Ba'zi qadimgi rimliklar juda boy edi va ularning chiroyli
  g'isht uylari bor edi. Tashqi devorlarda deraza yo'q edi
  va polda gilam yo'q edi. Boshqa odamlarning kichikroq
  uylari yoki kvartiralari bor edi. Qadimgi Rimda tor
  ko'chalar bor edi, lekin ko'p teatrlar bor edi. Umumiy
  hammomlar juda mashhur edi. Erkaklar va ayollar u yerga
  turli vaqtlarda bora olardi, lekin bolalar hammomdan
  foydalana olmasdi. Ov qilish, ot minish, baliq ovlash va
  do'stlar bilan ziyofat qilish ham mashhur bo'sh vaqt
  mashg'ulotlari edi. Bolalar uchun ko'p o'yin va o'yinchoq
  bor edi. O'g'il bolalarning sevimli o'yinlari to'p
  o'yinlari edi, qizlarda esa o'ynash uchun qo'g'irchoqlar
  bor edi. Bolalar shuningdek it, mushuk, o'rdak va g'ozni
  uy hayvoni sifatida boqishardi. Qadimgi rimliklarda
  go'sht, baliq, meva, sabzavot va non kabi ko'p mazali
  taomlar bor edi, sevimli ichimliklari esa vino edi.

QAYSI SO'ZNI TANLASH — QOIDA:
  ega + SIFAT/joy      → was / were   (was — birlik)
  ega + NARSA (mulk)   → had
  'There ...' + narsa  → there was / there were
  QOBILIYAT, ruxsat    → could / couldn't

DIQQAT — 'ANY' INKOR BELGISI:
  'There ...... ANY windows' → WEREN'T
  'any' tasdiq gapda deyarli ishlatilmaydi.

items.textEn: Some ancient Romans 1) ............ very rich ...
items.whyUz:
'rich' — SIFAT → 'to be' kerak.
'Romans' ko'plik → WERE.
'ancient' = qadimgi.

items.textEn: ... and they 2) ............ beautiful brick houses.
items.whyUz:
'houses' — narsa, mulk → HAD.
'had' hamma ega uchun bir xil.

items.textEn: There 3) ............ any windows on the outside walls ...
items.whyUz:
'ANY' inkor gapda ishlatiladi → WEREN'T.
'windows' ko'plik → weren't (wasn't emas).
'the outside walls' = tashqi devorlar.

items.textEn: ... and there 4) ............ any carpets on the floors.
items.whyUz:
'ANY carpets' → WEREN'T.
Bu 16c-mashqning 1-savoliga javob:
rimliklarda GILAM yo'q edi.
'a carpet' = gilam; 'the floor' = pol.

items.textEn: Other people 5) ............ smaller houses or flats.
items.whyUz:
'houses or flats' — mulk → HAD.
'a flat' = kvartira (amerikacha: apartment).
Kambag'alroq odamlar haqida.

items.textEn: Ancient Rome 6) ............ narrow streets, ...
items.whyUz:
'Rome HAD narrow streets' — shahar tuzilishi haqida → HAD.
16a-mashqning 2-bandini tasdiqlaydi.

items.textEn: ... but there 7) ............ lots of theatres.
items.whyUz:
'There WERE lots of theatres'.
'theatres' ko'plik → WERE.
16c-mashqning 2-savoliga javob.
'lots of' = ko'p.

items.textEn: The public baths 8) ............ very popular.
items.whyUz:
'popular' SIFAT → 'to be'.
'baths' KO'PLIK → WERE.
'public' = umumiy, hammaga ochiq.

items.textEn: Men and women 9) ............ go there at different times, ...
items.whyUz:
Keyingi so'z FE'L ('go') → 'could' kerak.
'was/were/had' dan keyin asosiy fe'l kelmaydi.
Ma'nosi: RUXSAT bor edi.
'at different times' = turli vaqtlarda.

items.textEn: ... but children 10) ............ use the baths.
items.whyUz:
'but' oldingi tasdiqqa QARAMA-QARSHI → inkor.
Keyin fe'l ('use') → COULDN'T.
16c-mashqning 3-savoliga javob: BOLALAR foydalana olmasdi.

items.textEn: Hunting, riding, fishing and having dinner parties with friends 11) ............ also popular free-time activities.
There 12) ............ lots of games and toys for children.
items.whyUz:
'games and toys' ko'plik → THERE WERE.
16c-mashqning 4-savoliga javob: GAMES.

items.textEn: The boys' favourite games 13) ............ ball games ...
items.whyUz:
'games' KO'PLIK → WERE.
DIQQAT — 'the BOYS'' apostrofi 's' dan KEYIN:
ko'plik otda egalik apostrof oxirga qo'yiladi.

items.textEn: ... and the girls 14) ............ dolls to play with.
items.whyUz:
'dolls' — narsa, mulk → HAD.
16a-mashqning 4-bandini tasdiqlaydi.
'to play with' = o'ynash uchun ('with' oxirda qoladi).

items.textEn: Children also 15) ............ dogs, cats, ducks and geese as pets.
items.whyUz:
Hayvonlar — 'mulk' → HAD.
'a duck' = o'rdak; 'a goose' → 'GEESE' (noto'g'ri ko'plik!).
'as pets' = uy hayvoni sifatida.

items.textEn: The ancient Romans 16) ............ lots of delicious food to eat, ...
items.whyUz:
'food' — narsa → HAD.
'delicious' = mazali.
'such as' = ...kabi, masalan.

items.textEn: ... and their favourite drink 17) ............ wine.
items.whyUz:
'their favourite drink' — BIRLIK → WAS (were emas!).
16c-mashqning 6-savoliga javob: WINE.
'wine' = vino.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the text again, then read the sentences below and circle the correct items.
exercises.instructionUz: Matnni yana o'qing, so'ng quyidagi gaplarni o'qib to'g'ri variantni belgilang.
exercises.explanationUz:
Har bir savolning javobi 16b-matnda BOR —
faqat to'g'ri joyni topish kerak.

items.textEn: 1  The ancient Romans didn't have any ............ in their houses.
items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'there weren't any CARPETS on the floors'.
Stol va divan haqida matnda umuman aytilmagan.

items.textEn: 2  They had lots of ............ .
items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'but there were lots of THEATRES'.
Diskoteka va kinoteatr qadimgi Rimda bo'lishi MUMKIN EMAS —
ular ancha keyin paydo bo'lgan.

items.textEn: 3  ............ couldn't use the public baths.
items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'Men and women COULD go there ..., but children
COULDN'T use the baths'.
Erkaklar va ayollar bora olardi — faqat BOLALAR yo'q.

items.textEn: 4  There were lots of ............ and toys for children.
items.whyUz: Matnda: 'There were lots of GAMES and toys for children'.

items.textEn: 5  ............ was one of their favourite free-time activities.
items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'HUNTING, riding, fishing and having dinner parties
... were also popular free-time activities'.
Raqs va futbol matnda yo'q.

items.textEn: 6  Their favourite drink was ............ .
items.whyUz: Matnda: 'their favourite drink was WINE'.

exercises.instructionEn: Talk about what the ancient Romans could or couldn't do/what they had and what there was/wasn't in ancient Rome.
exercises.instructionUz: Qadimgi rimliklar nima qila olgan yoki qila olmagani / ularda nima bo'lgani va qadimgi Rimda nima bor yoki yo'q bo'lgani haqida gapiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
UCH XIL QOLIP BILAN GAPIRASIZ:

  1) COULD / COULDN'T  — qobiliyat, ruxsat
  2) HAD / DIDN'T HAVE — mulk, egalik
  3) THERE WAS / WERE (WASN'T / WEREN'T) — mavjudlik

Hammasi 16b-matndan olinadi.

DIQQAT — 'HAD' va 'THERE WAS' FARQI:
  They HAD dolls.        — KIMDADIR bor edi (ega bor)
  There WERE lots of toys. — UMUMAN mavjud edi (ega yo'q)

structure.heading: 1  could / couldn't
structure.guideUz:
Hammomlar haqidagi gapdan foydalaning.
Qolip: Men and women could ..., but children couldn't ... .
structure.modelEn: Men and women could go to the public baths at different times, but children couldn't use them.

structure.heading: 2  had / didn't have
structure.guideUz:
Uylar, qo'g'irchoqlar, uy hayvonlari, taom haqida.
Qolip: They had ..., but they didn't have ... .
structure.modelEn: Rich Romans had beautiful brick houses, but they didn't have any carpets on the floors.

structure.heading: 3  there was / there wasn't
structure.guideUz:
Teatrlar, o'yinlar, derazalar haqida.
BIRLIK → there was;  KO'PLIK → there were.
structure.modelEn: There were lots of theatres and games in ancient Rome, but there weren't any windows on the outside walls.

structure.heading: 4  Bo'sh vaqt
structure.guideUz:
To'rtta mashg'ulotni sanang.
Barchasi -ing shaklida (ot vazifasida).
structure.modelEn: Hunting, riding, fishing and having dinner parties with friends were popular free-time activities.

wordFormation.introUz: 66-bet — could, qadimgi Rim lug'ati, sifat juftlari.

groups.explanationUz: Modal fe'l — hamma ega uchun bir xil, -s olmaydi.
Bittasi tasdiq, ikkinchisi inkor bilan keladi.
Fe'lga -ing qo'shilib, mashg'ulot nomi hosil bo'ladi.

patterns.exampleEn: Men and women could go there. Children couldn't use the baths.
patterns.exampleUz: Erkaklar va ayollar bora olardi. Bolalar hammomdan foydalana olmasdi.
patterns.explanationUz: 'could' dan keyin fe'l ASOSIY shaklda, 'to' siz va -ed siz.

patterns.formula: X could ... WHEN he was [yosh], but Y couldn't ... UNTIL he was [yosh].
patterns.exampleEn: Paul could talk when he was one, but Doug couldn't talk until he was two.
patterns.exampleUz: Pol bir yoshida gapira olardi, lekin Dag ikki yoshigacha gapira olmasdi.

patterns.exampleEn: There weren't any windows on the outside walls.
patterns.explanationUz: 'any' inkor va so'roq gaplarda ishlatiladi, tasdiqda emas.

patterns.formula: Ega + HAD + narsa.   ↔   There WAS/WERE + narsa.
patterns.exampleEn: They had dolls. There were lots of toys.
patterns.exampleUz: Ularda qo'g'irchoq bor edi. Ko'p o'yinchoq bor edi.
patterns.explanationUz:
HAD — kimdadir bor edi (EGA bor).
THERE WAS/WERE — umuman mavjud edi (ega yo'q).

patterns.formula: ..., such as A, B, C and D.
patterns.exampleEn: lots of delicious food, such as meat, fish, fruit, vegetables and bread
patterns.exampleUz: go'sht, baliq, meva, sabzavot va non kabi ko'p mazali taomlar
patterns.explanationUz:
'such as' = ...kabi, masalan — misol keltiradi.
Oxirgi ikki so'z 'and' bilan bog'lanadi.

patterns.exampleEn: Hunting, riding and fishing were popular free-time activities.
patterns.exampleUz: Ov qilish, ot minish va baliq ovlash mashhur mashg'ulotlar edi.
patterns.explanationUz: Mashg'ulot nomlari -ing bilan yasaladi va OT vazifasini bajaradi.
